title: Besicovitch covering estimate under a ball-wise mass ratio condition (printed step (2) of the proof of 8.3.7)
statement: For every N ∈ ℕ there is C ∈ ℕ (depending only on N) such that, for all Borel measures μ, ν on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, every set A ⊆ ℝ^N, every ρ₀ ∈ ℝ and every t ∈ [0,∞], the following holds. If each x ∈ A admits σ with 0 < σ < ρ₀ and μ(B_σ(x)) ≤ t·ν(B_σ(x)) (closed balls), then μ(A) ≤ C·t·ν(thickening(ρ₀, A)), where thickening(ρ₀, A) = {y : dist(y, A) < ρ₀} and μ(A) is the outer measure.
lean_statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < ρ₀ ∧ μ (closedBall x σ) ≤ t * ν (closedBall x σ)) → μ A ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * t * ν (thickening ρ₀ A)
